mapper.select: SELECT rule_id AS ruleId, status_type_id AS statusTypeId, rule_kind AS ruleKind, to_json(action_type_ids)::text AS actionTypeIdsJson, to_json(action_match_type_ids)::text AS actionMatchTypeIdsJson, to_json(interrupt_phase_type_ids)::text AS interruptPhaseTypeIdsJson, priority, description, extend::text AS extendJson FROM public.status_action_control_rules WHERE game_id = #{gameId} ORDER BY rule_id

SELECT rule_id AS ruleId, status_type_id AS statusTypeId, rule_kind AS ruleKind, to_json(action_type_ids)::text AS actionTypeIdsJson, to_json(action_match_type_ids)::text AS actionMatchTypeIdsJson, to_json(interrupt_phase_type_ids)::text AS interruptPhaseTypeIdsJson, priority, description, extend::text AS extendJson FROM public.status_action_control_rules WHERE game_id = #{gameId} AND rule_id = #{ruleId}

SELECT rule_id AS ruleId, status_type_id AS statusTypeId, rule_kind AS ruleKind, to_json(action_type_ids)::text AS actionTypeIdsJson, to_json(action_match_type_ids)::text AS actionMatchTypeIdsJson, to_json(interrupt_phase_type_ids)::text AS interruptPhaseTypeIdsJson, priority, description, extend::text AS extendJson FROM public.status_action_control_rules WHERE game_id = #{gameId} AND updated_at > #{updatedAfter} ORDER BY rule_id
mapper.update: INSERT INTO public.status_action_control_rules (game_id, rule_id, start_version_id, end_version_id, status_type_id, rule_kind, action_type_ids, action_match_type_ids, interrupt_phase_type_ids, priority, description, extend, updated_at) VALUES ( #{gameId}, #{ruleId}, #{versionId}, #{versionId}, #{statusTypeId}, #{ruleKind}, COALESCE( ( SELECT array_agg(value::int ORDER BY ord) FROM jsonb_array_elements_text(COALESCE(CAST(#{actionTypeIdsJson} AS jsonb), '[]'::jsonb)) WITH ORDINALITY AS arr(value, ord) ), ARRAY[]::int[] ), COALESCE( ( SELECT array_agg(value::int ORDER BY ord) FROM jsonb_array_elements_text(COALESCE(CAST(#{actionMatchTypeIdsJson} AS jsonb), '[]'::jsonb)) WITH ORDINALITY AS arr(value, ord) ), ARRAY[]::int[] ), COALESCE( ( SELECT array_agg(value::int ORDER BY ord) FROM jsonb_array_elements_text(COALESCE(CAST(#{interruptPhaseTypeIdsJson} AS jsonb), '[]'::jsonb)) WITH ORDINALITY AS arr(value, ord) ), ARRAY[]::int[] ), #{priority}, #{description}, CAST(#{extendJson} AS jsonb), NOW() ) ON CONFLICT (game_id, rule_id) DO UPDATE SET start_version_id = EXCLUDED.start_version_id, end_version_id = EXCLUDED.end_version_id, status_type_id = EXCLUDED.status_type_id, rule_kind = EXCLUDED.rule_kind, action_type_ids = EXCLUDED.action_type_ids, action_match_type_ids = EXCLUDED.action_match_type_ids, interrupt_phase_type_ids = EXCLUDED.interrupt_phase_type_ids, priority = EXCLUDED.priority, description = EXCLUDED.description, extend = EXCLUDED.extend, updated_at = NOW()

INSERT INTO public.status_action_control_rules_log (game_id, rule_id, start_version_id, end_version_id, status_type_id, rule_kind, action_type_ids, action_match_type_ids, interrupt_phase_type_ids, priority, description, extend) VALUES ( #{gameId}, #{ruleId}, #{versionId}, #{versionId}, #{statusTypeId}, #{ruleKind}, COALESCE( ( SELECT array_agg(value::int ORDER BY ord) FROM jsonb_array_elements_text(COALESCE(CAST(#{actionTypeIdsJson} AS jsonb), '[]'::jsonb)) WITH ORDINALITY AS arr(value, ord) ), ARRAY[]::int[] ), COALESCE( ( SELECT array_agg(value::int ORDER BY ord) FROM jsonb_array_elements_text(COALESCE(CAST(#{actionMatchTypeIdsJson} AS jsonb), '[]'::jsonb)) WITH ORDINALITY AS arr(value, ord) ), ARRAY[]::int[] ), COALESCE( ( SELECT array_agg(value::int ORDER BY ord) FROM jsonb_array_elements_text(COALESCE(CAST(#{interruptPhaseTypeIdsJson} AS jsonb), '[]'::jsonb)) WITH ORDINALITY AS arr(value, ord) ), ARRAY[]::int[] ), #{priority}, #{description}, CAST(#{extendJson} AS jsonb) ) ON CONFLICT (game_id, rule_id, start_version_id) DO UPDATE SET end_version_id = EXCLUDED.end_version_id, status_type_id = EXCLUDED.status_type_id, rule_kind = EXCLUDED.rule_kind, action_type_ids = EXCLUDED.action_type_ids, action_match_type_ids = EXCLUDED.action_match_type_ids, interrupt_phase_type_ids = EXCLUDED.interrupt_phase_type_ids, priority = EXCLUDED.priority, description = EXCLUDED.description, extend = EXCLUDED.extend
